questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that your road meets a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or barrier.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign alerts drivers to a school zone or school crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This white rectangular sign with black markings is a regulatory sign. You must obey it. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downgrade is coming. Check your brakes before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You often see this sign at intersections with heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings tells you a winding road is ahead. Slow down to a safe speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means Stop. Come to a complete stop, let traffic and pedestrians pass if they have the right-of-way, then proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings tells you a stop sign is coming. Be ready to stop completely before you go further.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells you the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic signals are ahead. Be prepared to stop or slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: You must come to a complete stop at this sign. Look left, right, and left again before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk where pedestrians cross. Stay alert and watch for people in the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: Do not enter from this direction. The road is one-way and you are going the wrong way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: This five-sided sign means you are near a school. Slow down and be prepared to stop for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This diamond-shaped yellow warning sign tells you the road may be slippery when wet. Reduce your speed and be careful to maintain control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A steep hill is ahead. Slow down to avoid damaging your brakes or losing control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: Slow down and let other vehicles go first. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that cyclists may cross the road ahead. Watch for bicycles and be ready to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This pennant-shaped yellow sign marks an area where you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A steep hill is ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A steep downhill grade is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked line. Proceed only when it is safe. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk or intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower in bad weather or poor conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: The road will curve sharply to the right and then sharply to the left ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of an intersection ahead where a road joins from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means the action is prohibited. U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turns permitted on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot turn right at this location.
